description: Roles & permissions surface (#52, live-probed 2026-08-12). The graph-side artifact of a role is the step-assignee Resource node (template below); everything else lives on flow-level API surfaces: member/batch (two axes: Role + Permission[]), report member/batch (views ARE reports), and AppRole.Preference (per-role default page/navigation).
notes: The builder's 4-tier role screen (No-access/Read-only/Edit/Manage) is NOT a wire enum — no route returns those words. The real mechanism is TWO axes on the documented member/batch route: Role (who the AppRole IS on the flow) + Permission[] (extra grants). The tier->wire mapping is a HYPOTHESIS pending a human diff against the real builder role screen.

Role vocabulary is FLOW-TYPE-SCOPED (proven by bisection against KISSFLOW_ERROR_04230): process = Admin | DataAdmin | Member; form = Admin | Member | Viewer; report = Admin | Member. Board (case) not probed this pass — a read-only scan of a real board app saw only Role:Admin, Permission:[].

Permission[] vocabulary is ROLE-AND-FLOW-TYPE-SCOPED (against KISSFLOW_ERROR_04231): Admin accepts [] ONLY on every flow type (implicitly full-access, every flag 400s); process Member/DataAdmin accept InitiateItems | View; form Member accepts Edit | View | Delete | Share; form Viewer accepts ReadOnly; report Member accepts Edit | View | Share (no Delete — differs from form Member).
A re-POST of member/batch REPLACES the Permission array, not additive — [View,Edit] then [View,Delete] reads back exactly [View,Delete].
No-access = the AppRole simply ABSENT from the member list; no explicit-deny route exists — absence IS the deny.

Views ARE reports: the builder's table/kanban/chart views are report records (ViewType: Tabular | IconCard | BarColumnChart | ...). Per-view permissioning = the already-documented report member/batch route; read back via GET .../report/{rid}/member or the SharedWith array on the report record.

Per-role Default page + Default navigation: PUT /app_role/2/{acct}/{role_id} body {"Preference": {"DefaultPage": <page _id or "Default">, "DefaultNavigation": <Navigation node's own Id, e.g. Navigation001, or "Default">}} — write route newly proven, read back via GET /app_role/2/{acct}/{role_id}.

Copilot on roles: both asks landed on attempt 1, but reply text mismatched the graph both times — an 'Initiator access' ask wrote Role:Member, Permission:[] (which cannot submit, per the InitiateItems rule), an 'Admin access' ask wrote Role:DataAdmin, Permission:[InitiateItems]. Read-back is the record, never the reply.

Assignee template above: ValueType MUST be AppRole (a persisted ValueType:User publishes clean but is ignored at runtime), and assignees cannot be written before members exist — CLAUDE.md Members first.
